label: The opening mark of a comment or docstring (""", ''', #, //, /*) at the start of a line inside a function or class body in code, strongest right under the def/class header line, in any programming language. Plain code statements in the same slot stay near zero; a comment at the very top of a file before any code stays low; triple quotes used in prose or as a one-line query string outside a function stay low. Weak exception: a string opened inside a function body (print(" or msg = """) can fire moderately (about 0.3-0.5).

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit
